_metadata.note: Every source row the candidate does not contain, with the reason. Rows are identified by source line and source id only: the values that caused the rejection are summarised rather than reproduced, so a quarantine report does not become a second copy of the data it excluded.

reason_codes.name_empty: facility_name blank or a placeholder token
reason_codes.state_unmapped: state_name outside the explicit state table
reason_codes.coordinates_absent: longitude and latitude both blank; a locator record with no point is quarantined rather than emitted with nulls, and never given a substitute
reason_codes.coordinates_out_of_bounds: coordinates outside the Nigeria bounding box
reason_codes.coordinates_swapped_suspected: outside the Nigeria bounding box as given, inside it if the two fields were exchanged; NOT swapped automatically, because that is a guess about which field the source got wrong
reason_codes.coordinates_swapped_suspected_by_state: inside the bounding box, but more than 150 km from the reference point of the state the row claims as given and at least 2x closer with latitude and longitude exchanged; the same refusal as above, seen by a per-state yardstick because a northern transposition stays inside Nigeria. NOT exchanged. Both distances are in the detail
reason_codes.coordinates_not_in_state: more than 300 km from the reference point of the state the row claims under either reading; either the state or the point is wrong and the pipeline does not choose which
reason_codes.name_is_contact_detail: facility_name holds an email address or URL rather than a name; the row cannot be presented to a user and the value is not repeated here
reason_codes.duplicate_exact_match: an exact duplicate (same name, state, LGA and coordinates) of the record named in survivor_facility_id, which is in the candidate; the survivor is the smallest registry unique_id and no values were merged across the pair

deduplication_rule.key: casefolded normalised name + state + casefolded LGA + identical longitude and latitude as emitted
deduplication_rule.survivor: the member with the smallest registry unique_id, then the smallest source id — the earlier registration in the source's own sequence
deduplication_rule.not_collapsed: same name in the same LGA at a different point; same point under a different name. Both remain in the artifact and are counted as duplicate CANDIDATES in the quality report for a reconciliation decision.
